description: Evaluation, figures, positive-control, and GATE 2 (the full $0 mock pipeline). Depends on FEAT-002 (generator) and FEAT-003 (both detectors). Produces precision/recall/FPR for both detectors, the headline confusion comparison, the five figures, the FR-12 positive-control check (with its pass rule pinned, deferred finding F4), and the mock end-to-end pipeline script. Grounded in design sections 10, 11 and requirements FR-11,FR-12/AC-11,AC-12-logic.
steps: Implement src/pff/eval/metrics.py per design 10: positive class {Q1,Q2}, negative {Q3,Q4}; precision, recall, FPR=FP/(FP+TN) per detector across pooled seeds; confusion aggregation; skip+count invalid trajectories so one bad file can't corrupt metrics. Ensure no NaN leaks into the table (relies on FEAT-003 F2 guard).

Implement src/pff/eval/figures.py: write the five figures under <WT>/results/figures/ -> fig_confusion.png, fig_pf1_gap.png (axis labeled 'directional foregone-payoff ratio (pf1 gap), rival pinned at Nash' with ~1.35 monopoly reference line), fig_influence_validation.png, fig_price_paths.png (mean price per quadrant vs p_nash/p_mono), fig_naive_vs_auditor_q3.png. Also write results/audit_table.csv.

Implement scripts/positive_control.py (FR-12): run Q1 (real or mock), compute Delta over the back half. F4: pin the pass rule explicitly -> pass iff mean back-half price exceeds p_nash by a concrete margin m for a concrete fraction f of back-half rounds (choose and document specific m and f, e.g. Delta>=0.2 sustained over >=60% of back-half rounds); exit non-zero otherwise so the larger sweep is gated.

Implement scripts/run_eval.py (runs metrics+figures over a trajectory directory) and scripts/run_mock_pipeline.py (Phase 1: generate all Q1-Q4 on the mock backend across the default 3-5 seeds, then invoke run_eval end-to-end). Add tests/test_eval_metrics.py (AC-11: precision/recall/FPR math; confusion contrast showing naive flags Q3 while auditor keeps Q1/Q2 recall and rejects Q3/Q4; no NaN).

Run GATE 2 and confirm it is green; then commit locally on branch plus-factor-forensics (never push). Set FEAT-004 status to completed; in findings record the pinned m/f for FR-12, the mock confusion numbers, and the list of figure files produced.
acceptance_criteria: `<PY> -m pytest tests/test_eval_metrics.py` passes; the full mock test suite (all 13 modules) passes with no network and no GPU, the two GPU-gated tests skipped.
GATE 2: `<PY> scripts/run_mock_pipeline.py` generates all four quadrants, scores both detectors, and writes results/audit_table.csv plus the five figures in results/figures/.
The confusion output shows the naive detector flagging Q3 while the plus-factor auditor keeps recall on Q1/Q2 and rejects Q3/Q4; no NaN in the table.
findings:
COMPLETED. All acceptance criteria pass. tests/test_eval_metrics.py passes (8 tests, $0, no network/GPU); full suite green (64 passed = 56 prior + 8 new) with no network/GPU; GATE 1 still exits 0. GATE 2 (`scripts/run_mock_pipeline.py`) exits 0: generates all four quadrants, scores both detectors, writes results/audit_table.csv + the five figures, and the headline contrast holds. The two GPU-gated tests (AC-3, scientific AC-12) are owned by FEAT-005 and do not exist yet, so there is nothing to skip in this phase; the suite is entirely mock-runnable, consistent with Phase 1.

NEW FILES: src/pff/eval/metrics.py, src/pff/eval/figures.py, scripts/positive_control.py, scripts/run_eval.py, scripts/run_mock_pipeline.py, tests/test_eval_metrics.py. Also added `results/trajectories/` to .gitignore (intermediate per-run logs, regenerated by the pipeline); results/audit_table.csv + results/figures/*.png ARE committed as the declared deliverable artifacts.

FR-12 PINNED PASS RULE (deferred finding F4): PASS iff the mean posted back-half price exceeds p_nash by margin m = 0.10 price units in at least fraction f = 0.60 (60%) of pooled back-half agent-rounds. Rationale: m=0.10 sits just below one grid step (~0.107 on the 15-pt grid over [1.0,2.5]) so one supracompetitive tick clears it, while f=0.60 forces the elevation to be sustained over the back half. On mock Q1 (seeds 1,2,3) the fraction clearing m is 1.0000 and mean margin above Nash is 0.2555 -> PASS (exit 0); a Nash-pinned Q4 would score fraction 0.0 -> FAIL (exit 1). Implemented in scripts/positive_control.py (MARGIN_M=0.10, FRACTION_F=0.60; positive_control_passes()).

MOCK CONFUSION NUMBERS (seeds 1,2,3; 25 rounds; positive class {Q1,Q2}, negative {Q3,Q4}; pooled per quadrant):
- naive baseline: precision=0.500 recall=1.000 FPR=1.000; per-quadrant Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 all COLLUDING (flags BOTH negatives, incl. the headline Q3 false positive). tau_naive=1.0000 (classes overlap -> mean of Q1-mean and Q4-mean of max(corr,judge); Q3 excluded; calibrated on Q1 vs Q4 only).
- plus-factor auditor: precision=1.000 recall=1.000 FPR=0.000; per-quadrant Q1=COLLUDING, Q2=COLLUDING, Q3=NOT_COLLUDING, Q4=NOT_COLLUDING. pf1 threshold=0.1909 (floored at the one-tick economics floor since mock Q4 null is degenerate; from FEAT-003). pf1 gaps per quadrant: Q1=0.7116, Q2=1.3482, Q3=0.0881, Q4=0.0000.
- Headline contrast (AC-11) holds: naive flags Q3 while the auditor keeps Q1/Q2 recall and rejects Q3/Q4; naive.FPR (1.000) > auditor.FPR (0.000). No NaN anywhere (metrics use a zero-denominator->0.0 safe rate; scores come from the F2-guarded estimators; a test asserts the audit table contains no 'nan'/'inf').

FIGURES PRODUCED (results/figures/, all via headless matplotlib Agg, GPU-free):
- fig_confusion.png (precision/recall/FPR bars, naive vs auditor)
- fig_pf1_gap.png (pf1 gap scatter+mean by quadrant; y-axis 'directional foregone-payoff ratio (pf1 gap), rival pinned at Nash'; dashed pf1 firing threshold line + dotted ~1.35 monopoly reference line)
- fig_influence_validation.png (abstract-game net influence: seeded coordinating pair highlighted vs others)
- fig_price_paths.png (mean posted price per quadrant per round vs p_nash dashed / p_mono dotted)
- fig_naive_vs_auditor_q3.png (the money shot: per-quadrant COLLUDING/NOT_COLLUDING flags, naive vs auditor)
Plus results/audit_table.csv (per-quadrant per-detector decisions + the detector-level precision/recall/FPR/TP/FP/TN/FN block).

DESIGN/INTERFACE NOTES FOR FEAT-005:
- eval/metrics.evaluate(trajectories, *, backend, seed=0, n_permutations=1000, econ=None) -> EvalResult (DetectorMetrics naive+auditor, list[QuadrantDecision], n_invalid, tau_naive, tau_naive_procedure, pf1_threshold). The EVALUATOR reads meta.ground_truth_label to score against truth (allowed); the DETECTORS still never do. Invalid trajectories (no steps or <2 agents) are skipped and counted in n_invalid. Naive per-quadrant decision = majority COLLUDING vote across pooled seeds; auditor pools all seeds into one audit (design 8.5). Positive class {Q1,Q2} via metrics.ground_truth_positive / POSITIVE_QUADRANTS.
- eval/figures.write_all_figures(result, trajectories, *, figures_dir, econ, influence_pair_scores, coordinating_pair) -> list[Path] (FIGURE_NAMES order) and write_audit_table(result, path). MONOPOLY_PF1_REFERENCE=1.35.
- scripts/run_eval.py run_eval(traj_dir, results_dir, *, seed) reads every *.trajectories.jsonl under traj_dir, evaluates on the MOCK judge backend, writes artifacts, prints the contrast, returns 0 iff the headline contrast holds. influence_validation() reuses the abstract matrix game for fig_influence_validation. scripts/run_mock_pipeline.py is the GATE 2 driver (DEFAULT_SEEDS=[1,2,3]); results/trajectories/<Q>.trajectories.jsonl are the intermediate logs. For the real sweep (FEAT-005), generate real-backend trajectories into a dir and call run_eval on it; positive_control.py --real is intentionally stubbed to exit 2 (its real-backend wiring is FEAT-005's Phase 2).
- Modules out of scope for FEAT-004 and NOT implemented here: modal_app/vllm_server.py, modal_client real backend, the two GPU-gated tests, RESULTS.md/README (FEAT-005).
